To plan this well, I need a few details:

1) Location and timing
- Which zoo and city are you planning to visit?
- Do you already have a specific date in mind, or a range of possible dates?
- What time window are you aiming for (e.g., 9am–2pm)?

2) Students and supervision
- What grade/age are the students?
- About how many students and how many adult chaperones?

3) Logistics
- How will you get there (bus, walking, cars)?
- Are there any budget constraints (tickets, buses, food)?

- Check weather for your target date and suggest better alternatives if needed
- Propose a detailed day-of schedule (timeline/itinerary)
- Help with a packing/supplies list and student/parent instructions
- Draft a calendar event description for your school calendar

Reply with what you know so far (even if some is undecided), and I’ll start structuring the trip around it.</action>

<action type="say">
Here’s what the forecast shows for Saturday, December 13, 2025 at the Minneapolis Zoo:

- Temperature: about 65°F  
- Conditions: Sunny with light wind (~8 mph)  
- Chance of rain: ~10%  
- Overall recommendation: “suitable” for a field trip

So that date looks very good for an outdoor-focused visit, as long as students have light jackets and sunscreen.

Proposed 3‑hour on-site schedule (example: 10:00 AM–1:00 PM)

- 10:00–10:15 – Arrival and orientation  
  - Disembark buses, tickets/check-in  
  - Restroom stop  
  - Quick overview of rules, safety, and meeting points  

- 10:15–11:15 – Outdoor exhibit block 1  
  - Focus on major outdoor habitats (e.g., large mammals, outdoor enclosures)  
  - Students in small groups with chaperones  
  - Optional: simple scavenger hunt/observation sheet (animal behaviors, adaptations, habitats)

- 11:15–11:45 – Lunch and break  
  - Eat at picnic/food area  
  - Restroom break  
  - Short check-in with groups (what they’ve seen so far)

- 11:45–12:30 – Outdoor exhibit block 2  
  - Rotate to different outdoor sections  
  - Allow a brief indoor stop if needed (warm-up, quick exhibit) but keep main focus outside  

- 12:30–12:45 – Regroup and departure prep  
  - Meet at pre-agreed location  
  - “One thing you learned” quick share-out  
  - Final headcount, restrooms, board buses and depart

Draft calendar event details

- Title: Zoo Field Trip  
- Date: Saturday, December 13, 2025  
- Time: 10:00 AM – 1:00 PM (on-site; you can extend earlier/later for bus travel if you prefer)  
- Location: Minneapolis Zoo, Minneapolis, MN  

- Description (you can paste/edit):

“Middle school field trip to the Minneapolis Zoo.  
Planned on-site time: 10:00 AM–1:00 PM (plus travel time by school bus).

Tentative itinerary:
- 10:00–10:15 – Arrival, check-in, restrooms, safety reminders  
- 10:15–11:15 – Outdoor exhibit exploration in small groups with chaperones  
- 11:15–11:45 – Lunch and restrooms  
- 11:45–12:30 – Second outdoor exploration block (with optional short indoor stop)  
- 12:30–12:45 – Regroup, reflection, and bus loading

Students should wear weather-appropriate layers and comfortable walking shoes and are encouraged to bring a water bottle and sunscreen. Standard school field trip behavior and budget guidelines apply.”

What would you like to adjust: the start/end time, including travel time in the calendar event, or the emphasis of the activities (e.g., more structured learning vs. more free exploration)?</action>
